_comment: Example for surf_beginner: walk west from a T spawn, jump, then air-strafe right/left/right/left. Exercises every interpolation mode. To use your own start: in game `tas_setstart surf_beginner`, then replace the start object below with "start": "surf_beginner".
name: example_surf

settings._comment: Checked against the running game before every run. tickrate cannot be changed at runtime (-tickrate launch option).

start._comment: info_player_terrorist from the map's entity lump; the player settles onto the floor below it.

yaw._comment: Unwrapped degrees. Each key's interp shapes the segment that starts at that key.

keys._comment: 'to' is exclusive: from 0 to 66 holds W on ticks 0..65
